name: queryEach
description: call the given UDF/Closure with every row (struct) in the query.
syntax: queryEach( query query, function closure, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description:
A closure function (UDF) with the following signature:

`function( row, rowNumber, recordset ){}`

Which is called for each row in the query.

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
